description: This file defines a ConfigurationProvider class within the AWS SDK for PHP, responsible for providing retry configurations through various means such as environment variables, INI files, or default fallbacks. It supports chaining multiple providers and caching the resulting configuration, facilitating flexible and customizable retry behavior for AWS service requests.

classes.name: ConfigurationProvider
classes.description: Provides various static methods to generate retry configurations for AWS SDK operations via environment variables, INI files, or defaults, with support for chaining and caching.

methods.name: defaultProvider
methods.description: Creates a default configuration provider that checks environment variables, shared config files, and fallback options, with optional caching.

methods.name: env
methods.description: Creates a configuration provider based on environment variables AWS_RETRY_MODE and AWS_MAX_ATTEMPTS.

methods.name: fallback
methods.description: Provides default retry configuration options when other sources are not set.

methods.name: ini
methods.description: Creates a configuration provider that loads configuration from an INI file, optionally specifying profile and filename.

methods.name: unwrap
methods.description: Resolves a configuration from various formats into a ConfigurationInterface object.
